name: My Lovin' (You're Never Gonna Get It)

info.album: My Lovin' (You're Never Gonna Get It) [Hype Radio Remix] (2022 Remaster)

podcast.body: This was En Vogue's follow-up hit in 1992, generated by producers Denzel Foster and Thomas McElroy by sampling another riff from James Brown's "The Payback." The tart kiss-off to a trifling man reached number two in May 1992, spent nearly eight months on the Hot 100, and became Billboard's seventh biggest hit of the year. It established a sassy persona for the group and led to a crossover with a larger pop audience. "My Lovin' parentheses, you're never gonna get it. A tart kiss-off to a trifling man reached number two in May 1992."
